pttV9.fx10Intent: If an in-host-process execution mode is ever admitted, the entire corpus runs again in that mode, and the EXPECTED result is DISCLOSURE-ONLY on all seven tokens on both platforms -- including FX-3, which must FAIL to enforce, and whose failure to enforce is the passing condition. A run in that mode that reports any cell as enforced is a defect in the test, the mode, or the table.
